g.text: Turkish climate law carries 4× Australia's justice density

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52514e

g.text: Every published Australian and Turkish law in the database with at least 30 passages: 29 Australian, 17 Turkish.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52514e

g.text: Colour marks the country here, not the classifier. Small grey figures are labelled passages over total passages.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52514e

g.text: Australia: 29 laws, 21,777 passages, 3.3% any justice · Türkiye: 17 laws, 3,514 passages, 14.2% any justice

text.style: font-size: 7.4px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #8a8983

g.text: Composition drives much of the country gap: Türkiye's set includes the Eleventh National Development Plan (924 passages, 27.5% justice-labelled), while Australia's largest law by volume is the Higher Education Support Act (3,526 passages, 4.1%).

text.style: font-size: 7.4px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #8a8983

g.text: 'Law' is the front-end category; policies are excluded by request. Of 63 published laws, 10 have no passages at all and a further 7 fall below the 30-passage floor.

text.style: font-size: 7.4px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #8a8983

g.text: All passage types included (not just body text), matching the deep-dive panel; passages under 20 characters dropped.

text.style: font-size: 7.4px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #8a8983

g.text: Source: Climate Policy Radar, PRODUCTION.PUBLISHED.PASSAGES (Snowflake), Aug 2026.
